title: Data Visualization with R: Base Graphics
description: A free, modern book on data visualisation with base R graphics: zero dependencies, publication-ready output, and a measured case for why base graphics still belongs in your toolkit. Builds to HTML, PDF and ePub with Quarto.
notes: Version 1.0. All measurements quoted in Chapter 1 are regenerable from the scripts in scripts/, stored as committed CSVs in data/. Nothing in scripts/ runs at knit time, so the book builds with no dependencies beyond knitr and rmarkdown.
